overview.description: The Aptus April Deep Buffer ETF (APDB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to provide both limited downside protection and upside participation in the price performance of SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) over a twelve-month period. The fund uses FLEX options to pursue this investment objective. APDB was launched on May 5, 2026 and is issued by Aptus Capital Advisors.
